hero_desc: Click to choose files, or drag them here
hero_hint: Phone and PC on the same Wi-Fi · data goes directly over the LAN, never the internet
empty_desc: Uploaded files appear here for every device to download
qr_tip:
Scan with the phone camera or browser
to open the same transfer page.
sheet_sub: The background is stored only in this browser and is never uploaded; a new device or cleared cache restores the default.
dim_tip: Higher values darken the background and keep text readable; 0% shows the original image.
opacity_tip: The web build uses a dark layer with alpha plus backdrop blur; lower values let more background through.
token_invalid: Invalid access token. Scan the QR code on the computer again.
connect_failed: Could not connect to the service
qr_fail: Could not generate the QR code; enter the address manually
token_expired: The token expired. Scan the QR code on the computer again.
files_fail: Could not load the file list
download_interrupted: Download interrupted, kept {size}. Refresh the page and tap download to resume.
download_interrupted_toast: Download interrupted: {reason}. Tap download to resume.
upload_network: Network lost. Check Wi-Fi and tap retry.
queued: Added {count} files, up to {n} upload at once
busy_upload: Transfer in progress, try again shortly
copy_failed: Copy failed, please enter it manually
bg_need_image: Choose a JPG / PNG / WebP / BMP image
bg_too_big: Image is over 8 MB, compress it first
bg_saved_but: Background applied, but the browser could not save it
